BrochureContent.Content:
'The Cottage' Knockroe, Kilnamartyra, Co Cork P12 K377
OM2 O'Mahony are delighted to present this wonderful traditional Irish cottage, beautifully positioned on an idyllic south-facing site extending to approximately 1.16 acres in the peaceful countryside of Knockroe, Kilnamartyra. Surrounded by mature hardwood trees and established woodland, the property enjoys an attractive rural setting with lovely views overlooking the Toon Valley, offering privacy, character and a wonderful connection with its natural surroundings.
The cottage has been thoughtfully enhanced and regenerated to provide comfortable living standard while carefully retaining the charm and character of the original property.
Its located less than 35 minutes from Cork City, so it is within commuting distance and is only 8 minutes from Macroom Town.

Location
The property enjoys a peaceful countryside setting at Knockroe, Kilnamartyra, surrounded by mature trees, woodland and rolling countryside. Despite its rural position, it is conveniently located approximately 8 minutes from Macroom, providing easy access to shops, schools, cafés, restaurants and everyday services.
Cork City is less than approximately 35 minutes away, making the property an attractive option for those seeking a countryside home while remaining within commuting distance of the city. The combination of its south-facing setting, mature grounds and accessibility to Macroom gives the property an excellent balance between rural living and convenience.

Accommodation: 
Kitchen / Dining Room
A character-filled kitchen and dining space with tiled flooring, fitted kitchen units and part-tiled walls. A traditional Stanley range forms a lovely focal point and complements the cottage character. The room is plumbed for both a washing machine and dishwasher and also features a radiator and original ceiling. A pine door leads through to the sitting room.
Sitting Room
A cosy living space with tiled flooring and an original ceiling, continuing the traditional feel of the cottage.
Landing
Accessed via solid timber stairs, the carpeted landing benefits from natural light provided by a Velux window overhead.
Bedroom 1
A particularly charming bedroom featuring a wooden ceiling with exposed beams, original tongue-and-groove timber flooring and part-panelled walls. Further details include designer-style window shutters and a radiator.
Bedroom 2
A second comfortable bedroom retaining its original wooden flooring and complemented by designer-style window shutters and a radiator.
Bathroom
Finished with tiled flooring and part-tiled walls and fitted with white sanitary ware and a stand-in electric shower. Additional features include a window shutter, radiator, wall-mounted heater and hot press.

Garden & Lands:
The property stands on approximately 1.16 acres, a gravel driveway provides ample parking to the front, with steel fencing defining the roadside boundary. Steps with railway sleeper detailing lead to the side garden, while a raised patio area is positioned to the rear.
The property also benefits from a barn-style shed and separate block-built shed measuring approximately 3.4m x 2.7m, providing useful outdoor storage.


Additional Details: 
Oil Fired Central Heating 
Painted teak double-glaze windows
Gross internal living area: c. 62sqm

Highlights: 
•Charming traditional Irish cottage full of character 
•Set on c. 1.16 acres with a south-facing aspect 
•Beautiful views overlooking the Toon Valley 
•Just 8 minutes from Macroom Town 
•Less than 35 minutes from Cork City
